data.one_liner: Create guided tours and coachmarks for Flutter widgets
data.what_it_does: Hotspot lets you attach callouts to any widget and run a step‑by‑step flow. It uses a provider to manage state and displays overlays with titles, text and optional actions.
use_when: You need a quick onboarding tour for a new screen
You want to highlight new features in an app
You need a lightweight, no‑code‑generation solution for tutorials
avoid_when: You require highly custom animations or complex branching logic
You need to integrate with a state‑management library that conflicts with provider
strengths: Built on provider, easy to integrate
Supports multiple platforms (android, ios, web, desktop)
weaknesses: Limited customization of the overlay appearance
No built‑in branching or conditional logic
Relies on provider, so not suitable if you avoid it
data.setup_notes: Wrap the widget tree with HotspotProvider and call HotspotProvider.of(context).startFlow() to begin.
